newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pontiac Marina unit signs S$750 mln facility.
newsitem.headline: Pontiac Marina unit signs S$750 mln facility.

text.p: PLPM Properties Ltd, a unit of hotels and property group Pontiac Marina Private Ltd, signed a Singapore $750 million finance facility on Monday, joint arranger and lead manager United Overseas Bank Ltd (UOB) said.
The finance consists of a S$400 million transferable loan facility with an embedded floating rate note call option and a S$350 million fixed rate loan facility with an embedded bond call option.
The other joint arrangers and lead managers were the Development Bank of Singapore Ltd and Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp, UOB said in a statement.
UOB said the funds would be used to re-finance Pontiac's Millenia Tower, a 41-storey 100 percent leased office tower which is part of Pontaic's S$2 billion Millenia Singapore project.
